questions.q: What does the author compare personal challenges to?
questions.why: The metaphor of a mountain represents the block to growth.

questions.q: According to the book, what drives self‑sabotage?
questions.why: The subconscious is said to cause self‑sabotage by masking core needs.

questions.q: What habit hinders growth despite meeting basic needs?
questions.why: Comfort‑seeking is described as a survival instinct that can block progress.

questions.q: How can one tell if a thought is intuition or fear?
a: Feel if it is calm, rational and non‑panicky
questions.why: Calm, sensible thoughts indicate intuition, while panic suggests fear.

questions.q: What is the first step to understanding why we make certain decisions?
a: Identify core commitments that drive us
questions.why: Finding core commitments reveals the root cause of our actions.
